newsitem.title: INDIA: India's central bank moves to cut interest rates.
newsitem.headline: India's central bank moves to cut interest rates.

text.p: India's central bank on Tuesday reduced the ceiling on interest on deposits up to one year by one percentage point to give banks more leeway to cut lending rates.
The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said the maximum interest rate on deposits up to one year was being cut to 9.0 percent a year from 10 percent.

The RBI also said it was removing reserve requirements on inter-bank borrowings. Banks in India now avoid borrowing on their fortnightly reporting day because borrowings on this day attracts reserve requirements.
The move is expected to pave the way for the creation of an inter-bank, term-lending market.
